proposition: Almost to a man the Turkas of Isfahan were qadis, poets, philosophers and religious scholars, often given to the esoteric sciences; the qadi office was heritable in the family under Timurids and Safavids, and the family identity shifted from Shafiʿi to Shiʿi under the Safavids, a shift Melvin-Koushki calls hardly dramatic.

mediation.note: a synthesis over centuries of the family; Ibn Turka's own generation is only a part of it
